plan_reconciliations.reason: Measured against the clips actually on disk: ev-8's retry clip places the phone's top edge on the upper-band boundary, so its moment moves to ev-9, whose subject sits entirely below 0.4 of the frame. ev-10's clip is a lone phone on a plain table under a plain tiled wall, so the moment belongs in the upper band rather than the centre the phone occupies.

Reviewed geometry: ev-12's subject head sits inside the upper third, so its declared band is genuinely occupied and no serviceable alternative exists. The moment moves to ev-11, whose two figures sit below four tenths of the frame with a plain wall above; its annotation is corrected to match the face box already recorded there.
